text:
Priya S: Quick postmortem note from last night's partner co-host webinar surge. ~80 leads came in; round-robin skipped many and we later saw ~20 duplicate owner swaps. SLA is 30m business hours. We need a low-risk pattern to keep first-touch under SLO and avoid flip-flop churn.
Diego V: I dug in. Two things: 1) HubSpot fanout sent duplicate webhook deliveries in some windows; 2) our sticky-owner expiry and enrich wait race caused reassignment when enrich arrived late -> duplicate owners.
Sam L: Given partner leads often have incomplete metadata, enrich latency is higher. Idea: implement a "confidence-banded preclaim" where we pre-assign into confidence buckets (high/medium/low) with different TTLs and clear semantics, so sales sees an initial owner but it's marked as provisional and will not trigger outreach until confidence is high.
Alex C: I like that. Banding rules could be simple: if enrich returns within 45s -> high, 45-120s -> medium, >120s or missing -> low. Preclaim assigns to different pools: high -> normal-sdr, medium -> overflow-sdr, low -> nurture-bot. Each preclaim writes a header X-Claim-Status:preclaim and X-Claim-Confidence:low/med/high.
Priya S: Important: avoid duplicate outreach. Sales must treat low/med as Do Not Contact until X-Claim-Confidence becomes high. We'll draft a 1-paragraph note. Also want metrics: preclaim_count, preclaim_to_final_swap_rate, duplicate_owner_events.
Sam L: Router pseudocode sketch: if (lead.is_partner && !enrich.completed) { assign_conf = preclaimConfidence(lead); enqueueAssign(lead, poolFor(assign_conf), metadata={"X-Claim-Status":"preclaim","X-Claim-Confidence":assign_conf}); set ttl per band; } on enrich callback: if (confidence becomes 'high' && current_owner != enriched_owner) { if (swap_count < 1) replaceOwner(lead,enriched_owner) }
Alex C: We'll also dedupe by HubSpot webhook id to avoid double processing when fanout repeats. Simple idempotency: store last_hs_event_id per lead for 2 minutes.
Diego V: Rollout plan: feature flag ff.preclaim.banded=true, scope to tag:partner-webinar, sources:[partner-signup], exclude enterprise=true. Canary 5% for 1h, monitor metrics around duplicates and time_to_first_claim. If duplicate_owner_events increase -> rollback.
Priya S: Also set a short human-visible TTL: low=60m, med=30m, high=10m. That way low-preclaims won't create permanent ownership.
Sam L: I'll add dashboard panels: time_to_first_claim_by_confidence, preclaim_count_by_band, swap_rate. Alert: page if duplicate_owner_events > 3 in 30m.
Alex C: PR will include code to set headers and the idempotency guard. Small snippet: ```
// preclaim flow
if (lead.tags.includes('partner-webinar') && !enrich.done) {
  band = preclaimBand(lead) // low|med|high
  if (!lead.flags.preclaim_sent) {
    lead.flags.preclaim_sent = true
    enqueueAssign(lead, poolFor(band), {headers:{'X-Claim-Status':'preclaim','X-Claim-Confidence':band}})
    setTTL(lead, ttlFor(band))
  }
}
```

Priya S: Sales note: "Preclaims marked X-Claim-Status:preclaim are provisional. Only engage when X-Claim-Confidence:high or when enrichment owner is set." I'll post to #sales and add a short FAQ.
Diego V: PR: https://git.redwood/routing/pull/1320 - feature flag + band config. Will run unit & replay tests.
Sam L: Running replay with partner CSV and simulated HS fanout; will watch duplicate_owner_events and time_to_first_claim. ETA 45m.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed at 2024-07-20T03:55:00Z - success
Alex C: Canary metrics so far: preclaim_count=82, preclaim_to_final_swap_rate=12%, duplicate_owner_events=0, median time_to_first_claim=7m (was 41m). Looks promising.
Priya S: Good. Keep canary for 2h then evaluate. After rollout, let's bake into runbook a permanent fix to dedupe fanout at ingress and revisit sticky-owner expiry logic. Thanks team :rocket:
